meta.description: Optimal Supabase schema for Silpi Architects Dashboard — maps 1:1 to App.jsx screens (Dashboard / Project Detail / Billing Schedule / Bill & Payment Tracker / Users)

enums.name: bill_status
enums.note: DB stores Billed/Paid/Overdue only — Partially Billed/Partially Paid are derived in app/views from payments + billing_stages. Keep enum narrow in DB, expand in view/app logic if needed.

tables.name: users
tables.description: Team members — drives role gating, incharge selects, and audit FKs
tables.dashboard_use: Sidebar 'Viewing As', User Management table, all Incharge dropdowns, project_incharge/site_incharge/drawing_incharge FKs

fields.name: id
fields.description: PK

fields.name: auth_user_id
fields.description: Supabase Auth link. Nullable so you can seed users before they sign up

fields.name: employee_code
fields.description: Human code shown in User Management

fields.name: role
fields.description: Controls NAV visibility & edit permissions

indexes.name: idx_users_name_trgm
indexes.note: for ILIKE search on incharge filters

tables.rls: Enable RLS; policy: authenticated can read all; only Admin can insert/update/delete

tables.name: projects
tables.description: Core project registry — one row per project
tables.dashboard_use: Dashboard table (all columns), StatCards (contract totals), Project Detail InfoCards, Billing Schedule header

fields.name: number
fields.description: Project number, shown as eyebrow on detail page, searchable

fields.name: name
fields.description: Searchable project name

fields.name: category
fields.description: Villas | Residences | Hospitality | Apartments. Use text for flexibility or convert to enum/project_categories table later

fields.name: total_area
fields.description: Kept as text to match existing seed. RECOMMENDATION: split into total_area_value numeric + total_area_unit text for sorting/filtering

fields.name: contract_value
fields.description: Original contract value (₹)

fields.name: revised_contract_value
fields.description: Used for StatCard 'Total Contract Value' — sum scope

fields.name: project_incharge_id
fields.description: Display-only in detail header

fields.name: site_incharge_id
fields.description: Editable by Admin/Team Lead inline + bulk

fields.name: drawing_incharge_id
fields.description: Editable by Admin/Team Lead inline + bulk

fields.name: drawing_status
fields.description: Filterable + bulk editable

fields.name: site_percent
fields.description: Progress bar % — drives avg site progress StatCard, filterable via minSite

tables.name: billing_stages
tables.description: Per-project billing schedule — template/plan for invoicing (1 project = N stages, pct should sum to 100)
tables.dashboard_use: Project Detail > Billing Schedule table (stage, %, amount, billed, remaining, status, Initiate Billing button)

fields.name: stage
fields.description: Stage label

fields.name: pct
fields.description: % of contract for this stage

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Precomputed: round(contract_value * pct / 100) or manually set. Shown as Amount

fields.name: sort_order
fields.description: Display order — Mobilization first, Handover last

indexes.name: uq_billing_stages_project_stage
indexes.note: prevent duplicate stage names per project

constraints: CHECK pct sum per project = 100 (enforce in app or via trigger, not strict DB check to allow draft states)

tables.name: bills
tables.description: Invoices raised against a project (optionally linked to a billing_stage). Amount = base; total = amount + taxes - deductions
tables.dashboard_use: Project Detail > Bills & Payments table + Global Bill & Payment Tracker (all columns). Powers Outstanding Bills StatCard via sum(total) where status != Paid

fields.name: bill_no
fields.description: Unique invoice number, searchable

fields.name: billing_stage_id
fields.description: Nullable — allows 'Other (custom)' bills not tied to schedule

fields.name: stage_label
fields.description: Denormalized stage name for display even if billing_stage_id is null or stage renamed

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Base bill amount before tax/deductions (₹)

fields.name: total
fields.description: Net invoice: amount + sum(bill_taxes.amount) - sum(bill_deductions.amount). Stored for fast aggregation

fields.name: date
fields.description: Invoice date, shown in tracker

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Optional notes, shown in tracker Comments col

tables.name: bill_taxes
tables.description: Tax line items per bill — supports multiple taxes (GST 18%, etc.)
tables.dashboard_use: Initiate Billing / New Bill forms (Taxes list), tracker Tax column (sum), net invoice calc

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Precomputed: round(bills.amount * pct / 100)

tables.name: bill_deductions
tables.description: Deduction line items per bill — TDS, discounts, retention, etc.
tables.dashboard_use: Initiate Billing / New Bill forms (Deductions list), net invoice calc (subtracted)

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Precomputed: round(bills.amount * pct / 100)

tables.name: payments
tables.description: Receipts against a bill — supports full and partial payments. Multiple rows per bill allowed
tables.dashboard_use: Paid / Remaining / paidSoFar columns in both bill tables, Outstanding Bills calc, Record Payment form, Mode (Bank/Cash) column

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Receipt amount

fields.name: received_via
fields.description: Bank/Cash mode shown in tracker

views.name: project_billing_totals
views.description: Aggregates per project for StatCards and dashboard Total Billed/Received columns — avoids N+1 queries
views.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW project_billing_totals AS SELECT p.id AS project_id, COALESCE(SUM(b.total),0) AS total_billed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.status='Paid' THEN b.total ELSE COALESCE(pay.total_paid,0) END),0) AS total_received FROM projects p LEFT JOIN bills b ON b.project_id=p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT bill_id, SUM(amount) AS total_paid FROM payments GROUP BY bill_id) pay ON pay.bill_id=b.id GROUP BY p.id;
views.actual_definition_hint: Your live view likely sums bills.total and payments — keep it; add index on bills(project_id) and payments(bill_id) to keep it fast
views.dashboard_use: Dashboard table Total Billed / Total Received cells + scope totals

views.name: bill_payment_totals
views.description: Per-bill paid/remaining — powers Paid/Remaining columns without client-side math
views.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW bill_payment_totals AS SELECT b.id AS bill_id, b.total, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS paid_so_far, (b.total - COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0)) AS remaining FROM bills b LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.bill_id=b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.total;
views.dashboard_use: Bills & Payments tables: Paid, Remaining; drives Partially Paid status + Record Payment remaining input

audit_tables.note: Your DB has *_edits tables for every base table (projects_edits, bills_edits, etc.) with (record_id, operation, old_data jsonb, new_data jsonb, changed_by, changed_at). Keep them — populated by trigger. Not queried by dashboard, used for audit/history.
audit_tables.trigger_sql_hint: CREATE TRIGGER trg_projects_audit AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON projects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.if_modified_func();

recommended_sql_additions.updated_at_trigger: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_updated_at() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END $$; -- then CREATE TRIGGER trg_projects_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON projects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at(); (repeat per table)
indexes_to_add_if_missing: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_name_number_trgm ON projects USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops, number gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bills_project_status ON bills(project_id, status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payments_bill ON payments(bill_id);
recommended_sql_additions.optional_normalization: ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_area_value numeric; ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_area_unit text DEFAULT 'sq.ft'; -- migrate total_area -> total_area_value + unit for numeric sorting/filtering

Dashboard > StatCards.Outstanding Bills: sum(bills.total) where status != 'Paid' via bill_payment_totals.remaining — filter by scope project_ids

Dashboard > Filters.q (name/no.): projects.name ILIKE %q% OR projects.number ILIKE %q% (trgm index)

dashboard_to_supabase_map.Project Detail > Billing Schedule: billing_stages where project_id=$1 order by sort_order; billed/remaining derived from bills joined to stages (or store billedAmount override via bills sum per stage)
dashboard_to_supabase_map.Project Detail > Bills & Payments & Glob: bills + bill_taxes + bill_deductions + payments + bill_payment_totals; filters on bill_no, stage_label, status, received_via

Forms.Initiate Billing: insert into bills + insert into bill_taxes/bill_deductions (in transaction)
Forms.Record Payment: insert into payments (bill_id, amount, received_via, date)
Forms.New Bill/Payment (manual): insert into bills (with stage_label custom or billing_stage_id) + taxes/deductions; if status=Paid also insert into payments

fetch_examples.getBills_full: const {data} = await supabase.from('bills').select('*, project:project_id(name), bill_taxes(*), bill_deductions(*), payments(*), bill_payment_totals:bill_payment_totals(paid_so_far,remaining)').order('date',{ascending:false})
